scripts.comment02: npm watch is at localhost/baby...., NOT at :8080
scripts.comment03: prebuild creates an importable version number
scripts.prebuild: node -p "'export const LIB_VERSION = ' + JSON.stringify(require('./package.json').version) + ';'" > src/version.ts  && cp ../jsxgraph/distrib/jsxgraphcore.js lib && node cleanFile.js
scripts.build: npm run prebuild && rm -rf dist.2.1.6/ && tsc --noEmit && webpack --config webpack.player.dev.js && npm run copylib2d && npm run copy2mathcode && npm run copy2playground
scripts.buildproduction: npm run prebuild && rm -rf dist.2.1.6/ && tsc --noEmit && webpack --config webpack.player.prod.js && npm run copylib2d && npm run copy2mathcode && npm run copy2playground && npm run copy2wrapper
scripts.copylib2d: cp -R lib/*.* dist.2.1.6 && cp -R lib/fonts dist.2.1.6 && cp -R lib/sounds dist.2.1.6 && cp -R lib/bootstrap dist.2.1.6 && cp -R src/tsxgraph.* dist.2.1.6 && cp -R src/tsxgraph.js dist.2.1.6/tsxgraph.mjs
scripts.buildeditor: rm -rf dist.2.1.6_editor && webpack --config webpack.editor.config.js && npm run copyeditor
scripts.copyeditor: cp src_editor/runtime/index.php dist.2.1.6_editor/index.php  && cp src_editor/runtime/3d.css dist.2.1.6_editor && cp -R assets dist.2.1.6_editor/assets
